pages.title: Raw Star Matter
pages.text: The matter of a star, as simulated inside a black hole. It behaves exactly as stellar material should, because the horizon simulates it perfectly. It glows with the light of a star that does not exist.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Feeding a Stellar Core and dark matter into the Eye of the Event Horizon, the black hole simulated a star, and the simulation left matter behind. Raw star matter, from computation.
